instruction.en: Join the English sayings to their meanings

pairs.left: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
pairs.right: a true friend helps in bad times

meaning.hi: सच्चा दोस्त मुसीबत में काम आता है

steps.question: Which river is called the life line of Madhya Pradesh?

questionMeaning.hi: किस नदी को मध्य प्रदेश की जीवन रेखा कहते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kis nadi ko Madhya Pradesh ki jeevan rekha kehte hain?

steps.modelAnswer: The Narmada is called the life line of Madhya Pradesh.

modelMeaning.hi: नर्मदा को मध्य प्रदेश की जीवन रेखा कहते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Narmada ko Madhya Pradesh ki jeevan rekha kehte hain.

steps.sentence: Bhola was not a fool. He was very ___.
